title: Sign a PDF
description: Add a visual signature to a page. This is a picture of your signature, not a digital certificate.

steps.title: Open the Sign menu
steps.text: Click Sign. The menu lists your saved signatures and initials. Open a PDF first if the items are greyed out.

steps.title: Create a signature
steps.text: In the Sign menu choose Manage signatures…. Add a new signature by drawing it, typing your name or importing an image, then choose Add to library. You only do this once.

steps.title: Choose a signature to place
steps.text: Open the Sign menu again and click the signature you want. The next click on the page will place it.

steps.title: Place it on the page
steps.text: Click where the signature should go. Use the Select tool to move it or drag a corner to resize it. Press Esc to cancel placing.

steps.title: Apply the signature
steps.text: With the signature selected, click Apply signature here (or in the Sign menu). It becomes part of the page and can no longer be moved. Undo reverses it until you close the file.

steps.title: Save the file
steps.text: Save to keep the signature in the PDF. It is a visual signature only, so it does not prove who signed.
